#!/usr/bin/env bash
R=/home/ubuntu/zenc/.claude/worktrees/fuzzrun
cd "$R"
export ZENC_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fz/cachecd
mkdir -p /tmp/fz/cachecd
agree=0; div=0; jsunsup=0; jsfail=0; cfail=0
: > /tmp/fz/corpusdiff_findings.txt
for f in tests/fixtures/zen/*.zen examples/*.zen; do
  co=$(timeout 60 ./zen run "$f" 2>/dev/null); crc=$?
  [ $crc -ne 0 ] && { cfail=$((cfail+1)); continue; }
  js=$(timeout 60 ./zen emit-js "$f" 2>/dev/null); jerc=$?
  [ $jerc -ne 0 ] && { jsunsup=$((jsunsup+1)); continue; }
  jo=$(printf '%s' "$js" | timeout 60 node 2>/dev/null); jrc=$?
  if [ $jrc -ne 0 ]; then jsfail=$((jsfail+1)); echo "JS-RUNTIME-FAIL $f (jrc=$jrc)" >> /tmp/fz/corpusdiff_findings.txt; continue; fi
  if [ "$co" = "$jo" ]; then agree=$((agree+1)); else
    div=$((div+1)); { echo "=== DIVERGENCE $f"; echo "--- C:"; printf '%s\n' "$co" | head -20; echo "--- JS:"; printf '%s\n' "$jo" | head -20; } >> /tmp/fz/corpusdiff_findings.txt
  fi
done
echo "AGREE=$agree DIVERGENCE=$div JS-RUNTIME-FAIL=$jsfail JS-UNSUPPORTED=$jsunsup C-FAIL=$cfail"
